question: Which open restaurants are located inside the central area roughly between latitude 38.71 and 38.72 and longitude -9.15 and -9.14?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.names.primary AS place_name, p.basic_category FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND p.operating_status = 'open' AND ST_Within(p.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.15, 38.71, -9.14, 38.72, 4326));

question: Can you list the historic sites that are within 15 metres of the Passeio Marítimo de Algés road?
sql: WITH road_geom AS ( SELECT ST_Transform(r.geometry, 4326, 32629, always_xy:=true) AS geom FROM lisbon_roads r WHERE r.names.primary = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés' ) SELECT DISTINCT p.names.primary AS site_name FROM lisbon_places p, road_geom rg WHERE p.taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site' AND ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(p.geometry, 4326, 32629, always_xy:=true), rg.geom, 15);

question: Which road segments meet the Passeio Marítimo de Algés at a junction?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r2.names.primary AS touching_road_name FROM lisbon_roads r1 JOIN lisbon_roads r2 ON ST_Touches(r1.geometry, r2.geometry) WHERE r1.names.primary = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés' AND r2.id <> r1.id;

question: Which road segments are completely inside the area bounded by longitude -9.16 to -9.13 and latitude 38.70 to 38.72?
sql: SELECT r.id, r.names.primary AS road_name, r.class FROM lisbon_roads r WHERE ST_Within(r.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.16, 38.70, -9.13, 38.72, 4326));

question: Show me places of interest that lie within 200 metres of any residential road.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.names.primary AS place_name, p.basic_category, p.operating_status FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_roads r ON ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(p.geometry, 4326, 32629, always_xy:=true), ST_Transform(r.geometry, 4326, 32629, always_xy:=true), 200) WHERE r.class = 'residential' LIMIT 100;

question: Which open places are contained within the rectangle covering the Baixa district roughly from -9.14 to -9.12 longitude and 38.71 to 38.72 latitude?
sql: SELECT p.names.primary AS place_name, p.basic_category FROM lisbon_places p WHERE p.operating_status = 'open' AND ST_Contains(ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.14, 38.71, -9.12, 38.72, 4326), p.geometry);
